description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Microprocessors and Microcontrollers topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: microprocessors

facts.claim: The microprocessor holds the CPU's arithmetic, logic and control

source.quote: The microprocessor contains the arithmetic, logic, and control circuitry required to perform the functions of a computer's central processing unit

facts.claim: A CPU on a single integrated circuit

source.quote: is included on a single integrated circuit (IC), or a small number of ICs

facts.claim: An address decoder selects the device or memory chip

source.quote: When the address for a particular device appears on the address inputs, the decoder asserts the selection output for that device

facts.claim: On an interrupt the processor saves state and runs an ISR

source.quote: the processor will suspend its current activities, save its state, and execute a function called an interrupt handler

facts.claim: Then it resumes the interrupted program

source.quote: allowing the software to resume normal activities after the interrupt handler finishes

facts.claim: The 8085 is an 8-bit microprocessor

source.quote: is an 8-bit microprocessor produced by Intel

facts.claim: TRAP cannot be disabled; EI/DI enable and disable the others

source.quote: All interrupts except TRAP are enabled by the EI instruction and disabled by the DI instruction

facts.claim: The 8086 is a 16-bit microprocessor

source.quote: is a 16-bit, complex instruction set microprocessor designed by Intel

facts.claim: Memory is accessed through segmentation

source.quote: This address space is addressed by means of internal memory "segmentation"

facts.claim: Assembly uses mnemonics for machine instructions

source.quote: Assembly language uses mnemonics to represent low-level machine instructions (opcodes)

facts.claim: An assembler converts it to machine code

source.quote: Assembly code is converted into executable machine code by a utility program referred to as an assembler

facts.claim: A programmable timer is a counter that signals at a programmed count

source.quote: a programmable interval timer (PIT) is a counter that generates an output signal when it reaches a programmed count

facts.claim: The 8051 is a single-chip microcontroller

source.quote: is a single-chip microcontroller (MCU) series developed by Intel

facts.claim: 8-bit ALU, accumulator and data bus

source.quote: 8-bit arithmetic logic unit (ALU) and accumulator, 8-bit registers

facts.claim: RISC uses simple instructions and few addressing modes

source.quote: RISC computers few and simple addressing modes and predictable instruction times

facts.claim: Speed per instruction via pipelining

source.quote: in particular by implementing an instruction pipeline

facts.claim: ARM is a family of RISC architectures

source.quote: ARM (stylised in lowercase as arm) is a family of RISC instruction set architectures

facts.claim: Low power suits battery devices

source.quote: Due to their low costs, low power consumption, and low heat generation

facts.claim: The 8087 was the floating-point coprocessor for the 8086

source.quote: The Intel 8087, announced in 1980, was the first floating-point coprocessor for the 8086 line

facts.claim: An ADC converts an analog voltage to a digital number

source.quote: converts an analog input voltage or current to a digital number

facts.claim: A DAC does the reverse

source.quote: A digital-to-analog converter (DAC) performs the reverse function
